text: Awesome!. I was surprised to see how big these gnomes really are. They are just so cute and light up Fairly bright. They have a good way to them so they're not Flimsy. They are very well made.

product_metadata.title: Ohuhu Gnome Christmas Ornaments, 2 Pack 18.5'' Lighted Gnome Christmas Decorations, Gnomes Plush Handmade Swedish Santa Tomte for Xmas Home Table Christmas Tree Indoor Outdoor Decor Gifts
features: 2PCS LIGHTED GNOMES: Good news! You will get 2 cute light up handmade plush stuffed Santa gnomes which can be placed anywhere to enhance the Christmas atmosphere. Bring them home and add a ton of luck to your family members! 3 AAA batteries are required when you want to light up the gnomes(not included in the package).

EXQUISITE WORKMANSHIP: Don't you want a gnome with exquisite workmanship? Made of acrylic fiber and filled with cotton, these plush toys are very soft. There are 2 modes of this gnome light. Turn it ''ON'' to keep the light up or choose ''OFF'' to light off the gnomes.

APPLICABLE SCENE: Wherever you put the adorable gnome, it'll light up your home and bring your family good mood every day. It can be perfectly combined with many occasions, used as a decoration for desks, tables, sofas, bookcases, shelves, bedside tables and more. You can also hang it on a Christmas tree for decoration.

SPREAD TRADITIONAL SPIRIT: In folk literature and art, gnomes guard their homes and protect people from misfortune, bringing good luck to the family. Plus, you can use them to tell children stories and express joy.

PERFECT GIFT: As we all know, the gnome is always a hit with friend and family! It turns out to be the best gift for children, girlfriends, wives and even pets during Christmas, holidays and party times! It will definitely bring you happiness and good luck.
